title: Account unlocked
body: I have unlocked your account. Wait 5 minutes, then sign in again. Reply here if it is still locked.

title: Engineer visit
body: An engineer will come to your desk today. Please leave the device switched on.

title: Forwarding to Facilities
body: Printers and office equipment are handled by Facilities — forwarding this to them now.

title: Refund approved
body: The refund has been approved and will reach the wallet within 48 hours.

title: Need approval documents
body: Please attach the approved quote or budget line so we can proceed.

title: Documents incomplete
body: Some claim documents are missing. Please send the burial permit and the claimant Ghana Card.

title: Sent for payout
body: The claim is verified and has been sent to Finance for payout release.

title: Form needed
body: Please attach your approved leave form so we can correct the balance.

title: Letter ready
body: Your letter is ready for collection at the HR office, or we can email a signed PDF.

title: Technician booked
body: A technician is booked and will arrive within 4 working hours.

title: Logged with vendor
body: This has been logged with the vendor. We will share their reference.

title: Acknowledge
body: Thanks — we have received this and will update you shortly.

title: Need more detail
body: Could you share a screenshot or reference number so we can look into this?

title: Resolved
body: This is now resolved. Please rate the service, or reopen it if anything is still wrong.
